infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: CreativeBridge needs microphone access so you can dictate your story ideas using voice input.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: CreativeBridge uses speech recognition to convert your voice input into text for story creation.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CreativeBridge needs access to your photo library to save and share your generated story illustrations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: CreativeBridge would like to save your generated story illustrations to your Photo Library.
